commits.message:
fix: prevent admin self-demotion via user edit form

Hide the Administrator checkbox when an admin edits their own profile,
and preserve admin status server-side when the checkbox is absent from
form data (self-edit case). This follows the existing self-protection
patterns used by deactivate and delete operations.

Closes #2794
